$$
L = 4 \times 3.141592653589793 \times (22)^2 \times 0.27
$$

Realizando las operaciones:

$$
L = 4 \times 3.141592653589793 \times 484 \times 0.27 = 1436.755 \times 0.27 = 387.914
$$
